notes.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Remake - now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Traverse the grotesque mansion once more and behold the Curien's masterpiece!

• Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
• True to the original gameplay
• Local 2-player multiplayer
• Multiple endings
• Photomode
• Achievements
• Armory with unlockable weapons
• Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
• Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694600/THE_HOUSE_OF_THE_DEAD_Remake/

notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg[/img]

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes


https://steamcommunity.com/app/992690/discussions/0/1652171126139342037/

notes.title: Qbik Update | October 31st
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31150835/30d5e236569292c493a0deefed8ca2caf58f18e3.jpg[/img]

Newest patch for Qbik on Steam is now live and ready to download! Among the bug fixes and tweaks we are adding some new elements like sound effects and move counter - read the full Patch Note below:


[h1]PATCH NOTE | October 31st[/h1]
New Features:
[list][*]Controller support!
[*]12 new Easter Eggs to discover
[*]New visual effects added: dripping water, teleports particles, stalagmites, and stalactites,
[*]New sound effects added: bubbling lava, teleport buzzing, and dripping water
[*]Added move counter on an upper right-hand corner
[*]Now you are able to reset your game progress to start over![/list]

Tweaks:
[list][*]Level skip counter increased to 6!
[*]Level 42 is entirely redesigned
[*]Qbik's sound effects are now a bit quieter[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list][*]Input is now blocked when skipping levels
[*]Fixed an issue with floating blocks
[*]Teleports now increase move count as intended[/list]

tags.feature: Controller support!
12 new Easter Eggs to discover
New visual effects added: dripping water, teleports particles, stalagmites, and stalactites,
New sound effects added: bubbling lava, teleport buzzing, and dripping water

Now you are able to reset your game progress to start over!

notes.title: Qbik update!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9VzcvLAiso56MRVXl5/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!
Thanks to your feedback on Steam forums, we were able to fix some issues you've encountered and add it on Steam! Make sure your game is up to date.

-------------------------
PATCH NOTES
[list][*]Fixed level 31 (bug with a block levitating over the lava)
[*]You may now use a teleport, even when Qbik can manage without it
[*]Blocked the ability to use a teleport when it's behind a locked gate
[*]Fixed an issue with two teleports being next to each other on Qbik's path[/list]

notes.title: Qbik update | 21 November 2017
notes.content:
Hi explorers!
Thank you for your feedback and bug reports! Thanks to your fast response we were able to prepare first update to fix existing issues and to add few tweaks.

Make sure your game is up to date and visit Steam forums to leave us feedback - http://steamcommunity.com/app/618470/discussions/0/3183345176715914909/

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Fixed levels 39 and 44.
[*]Fixed an issue with Qbik going through green blocks.
[*]Fixed sound and music settings in Options Menu.
[*]Skipped levels now counts toward finished levels count (but don't unlock achievements).
[*]Added 'Restart' button after finished level screen.
[*]Going back from Level Editor/custom level now brings to level search instead of the Main Menu.
[*]Unlocked, but not finished levels are now a bit darker to make them stand out.
[*]Few minor bug fixes.[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue with Qbik going through green blocks.
- Fixed sound and music settings in Options Menu.
- Skipped levels now counts toward finished levels count (but don't unlock achievements).

tags.feature: - Added 'Restart' button after finished level screen.
- Going back from Level Editor/custom level now brings to level search instead of the Main Menu.
- Unlocked, but not finished levels are now a bit darker to make them stand out.
